test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
The following Venn diagram represents the data collected in a survey conducted to know about the news reading habits of residents of a society. The triangle represents a set of newspapers readers, the rectangle represents a set of TV viewers and the circle represents a set of radio listeners, and the numbers represent the number of elements in the area. Look at the figure below and answer the question that follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35a2cc93cf01092550d340b79b314a38bea582114fa653aa87074970034c90ed.png] 

What is the total number of residents who rely on any ONE of the given media sources to get news updates?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c92abf066f138989c341f3512c17b0f7fd898e85a88748488db63cba1f8befd8.png] 

Here, shaded area shows the total number of residents who rely on any ONE of the given media sources to get news updates.

26 + 32 + 15 = 73

Hence, the correct answer is "**73**".
